title: Design Collaborative Real-Time Editing (Docs / Figma)
subtitle: Multi-leader CRDT state-vector sync, offline local-first queue, Read-Your-Writes & Consistent Hashing
functionalReqs: Support 100+ simultaneous editors per document across Tokyo, London, and Virginia with `<1ms` local keystrokes and `<80ms` peer delta sync.
Allow full offline editing cleanly stored locally and converged identically without lost writes upon network reconnection.
Maintain session-level Read-Your-Own-Writes consistency when browsing workspaces right after renaming/saving documents.

nonFunctionalReqs.target: Strong Eventual Consistency (identical state on all peers)
nonFunctionalReqs.rationale: Associative, commutative, idempotent Sequence CRDT merges any arrival order.
Only `K/N` documents shift during node autoscale without cluster storms.
Edge WebSocket hubs sync delta frames directly before async cold compaction.

explorerTopology.title: Global CRDT Multi-Leader Collaboration Mesh
explorerTopology.subtitle: Offline Client CRDT -> Consistent-Hashed WS Hub -> Kafka Cross-Region -> LSM Op-Log
explorerTopology.overview: How collaborative tools guarantee lock-free offline editing and deterministic cross-region convergence without single-leader round-trip bottlenecks.
keyTakeaways: Sequence CRDTs (`(lamport_clock, client_id)`) make edits commutative & idempotent even over arbitrary network partitions.
Logical virtual buckets (1,024 partitions via etcd) decouple physical server scaling from global document rehashing.

chaosScenarios.mitigationSummary: Both regions keep serving local WebSockets (`AP` availability). When link heals, State Vector diffing merges every causal CRDT operation deterministically in milliseconds with zero lost text.

steps.payloadInspector: Diverged epochs reconciled cleanly | Lost edits: 0

deepDives.title: Tombstone Garbage Collection & Snapshot Compaction
deepDives.bottleneck: Deleting 100k chars in a long doc leaves invisible CRDT tombstone IDs inflating memory & sync handshake size.
deepDives.solution: Track global minimum synced state vector across active checkpoints; fold settled history into clean compacted binary snapshots periodically.
deepDives.tradeoff: Requires brief offline clients reconnecting after 30+ days to pull a fresh snapshot rebase if old tombstones pruned.

deepDives.title: Local vs Global Secondary Index Rebalancing
deepDives.bottleneck: Scanning 1,024 doc shards (`Local Index`) blows up p99 latency when rendering user workspace dashboards.
deepDives.solution: Use async Global Term Index partitioned by `workspace_id`, paired with `X-Min-Causal-Epoch` session tokens for Read-Your-Own-Writes.
deepDives.tradeoff: Tiny async CDC lag (<250ms) replaced scatter-gather fan-out tail explosion.

criteria: Rejects naive LWW & single-leader bottlenecks; designs associative CRDT/OT state-vector convergence
Uses consistent hashing (VNodes) / decoupled fixed logical buckets to avoid full cluster rehashing
Covers `W+R>N`, Read-Your-Own-Writes session epochs, Monotonic & Consistent Prefix reads
Addresses CRDT tombstone compaction AND local vs global secondary index scatter-gather trade-offs
